name: Lethagoe
description: The Lethagoes were a mysterious hybrid species and a mix between Humans and Kalai. Lethagoes were Human in form but quite tall and thin. Nevertheless, they possessed a titanic strength that belied their thin frames. Their faces were thin and pale with a sharp nose, severe eyes and a jutting chin. Their appearance struck some as being quite birdlike, causing a theory to arise that the Kalai were an avian species.
